// Fixture for tests/unit/w558-test-waiters.unit.test.ts. Not compiled, not run:
// it holds exactly the shapes the guard must refuse, so that a scanner which
// quietly stops matching fails loudly instead of passing everything.

export async function handRolledPoll(ready: () => boolean): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + 5_000;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (ready()) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
  }
  throw new Error("timed out");
}

export function spinUntilElapsed(budgetMs: number): void {
  const startedAt = performance.now();
  for (;;) {
    if (performance.now() - startedAt >= budgetMs) return;
  }
}

export async function sleepThenAssert(expect: (value: unknown) => { toBe: (other: unknown) => void }): Promise<void> {
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
  expect(1).toBe(1);
}

// Evasion 1 (confirmed in review): a counter-bounded loop whose sleep is an
// aliased node:timers/promises import, never the literal setTimeout.
export async function counterBoundedPoll(ready: () => boolean): Promise<void> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt += 1) {
    if (ready()) return;
    await delay(10);
  }
  throw new Error("timed out");
}

// Evasion 2 (confirmed in review): a formatter wrapping the sleep across lines.
export async function wrappedSleepThenAssert(
  expect: (value: unknown) => { toBe: (other: unknown) => void },
): Promise<void> {
  await new Promise((resolve) =>
    setTimeout(resolve, 20));
  expect(1).toBe(1);
}
